one_liner_ko: 고성능 딥러닝 추론을 위한 NVIDIA의 개발자 도구 생태계(SDK).
what_it_does_ko: NVIDIA TensorRT는 추론 컴파일러·런타임·모델 최적화를 담아 프로덕션 앱의 저지연·고처리량 추론을 돕는 도구 모음이다. CUDA 위에서 주요 프레임워크로 학습한 모델을 최적화하고 저정밀도로 보정해 데이터센터·워크스테이션·노트북·엣지에 배포한다. 양자화·레이어/텐서 융합·커널 튜닝을 쓰며, TensorRT-LLM·Model Optimizer·TensorRT for RTX·TensorRT Cloud가 같은 생태계에 속한다. PyTorch·Hugging Face와 직접 통합되고 ONNX 파서를 제공한다.
key_features: RTX PC에서 15~30초 엔진 빌드(TensorRT for RTX)
제한된 파트너용 클라우드 엔진 최적화(TensorRT Cloud)
CPU 전용 대비 최대 36배 추론 가속(공식 주장)
use_cases_ko: 영상 분석·음성 AI·추천 시스템 등 프로덕션 추론 배포

pricing.free_tier: 부분 확인 (TensorRT-LLM은 GitHub 무료, Model Optimizer는 NVIDIA PyPI 무료로 명시; TensorRT 본체 가격 표기 없음)

evidence.quote: TensorRT SDK | NVIDIA Developer
NVIDIA® TensorRT™ is an ecosystem of tools for developers to achieve high-performance deep learning inference.
TensorRT includes inference compilers, runtimes, and model optimizations that deliver low latency and high throughput for production applications.
The TensorRT ecosystem includes the TensorRT compiler, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT Model Optimizer, TensorRT for RTX, and TensorRT Cloud.
TensorRT optimizes inference using quantization, layer and tensor fusion, and kernel tuning techniques.
FP8, FP4, INT8, INT4, and advanced techniques such as AWQ are supported
TensorRT integrates directly into PyTorch and Hugging Face to achieve 6X faster inference with a single line of code.
TensorRT provides an ONNX parser to import ONNX models from popular frameworks into TensorRT.
It facilitates faster engine build times within 15 to 30s
TensorRT Cloud is available with limited access to select partners.
Speed up inference by 36X compared to CPU-only platforms.
TensorRT provides developers a unified path to deploy intelligent video analytics, speech AI, recommender systems, video conferencing, AI-based cybersecurity, and streaming apps in production.
Safety-compliant and high-performance inference for Automotive Embedded
facilitating apps to build inference engines directly on target RTX PCs during app installation or on first run
